[[File:Helicarrier.jpg|thumb|234x234px|Helicarrier]]
The Helicarrier is that big flying craft which is shown on the main screen. When you start the game your Helicarrier will only have two facilities, The [[Generator]] and the Squad Bay, but early in the game, throughout the tutorial, players are able to build more facilities, which are the [[Research Lab]], [[Armory]] and Command Room. The Helicarrier does not take part in battles and cannot be upgraded.
